newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekend box office chart -- August 1-3.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekend box office chart -- August 1-3.

text.p: Following are the final data for the top 10 movies at the Aug. 1-3 box office, according to Exhibitor Relations Co.
NOTE: "Air Force One" and "Men in Black" are released by Columbia Pictures, a unit of Sony Corp.
"Spawn" is released by New Line Cinema, a unit of Time Warner Inc.
"George of the Jungle," "Air Bud" and "Nothing to Lose" are from Walt Disney Co.
"Picture Perfect" is released by 20th Century Fox, a unit of News Corp.
"Contact" is released by Warner Bros, a unit of Time Warner.
"Good Burger" and "Face/Off" are released by Paramount Pictures, a unit of Viacom Inc.
